definitions.explanation: An argument or quarrel between a married couple. Combines {夫婦|ふうふ} (married couple) + {喧嘩|けんか} (quarrel).

examples.japanese: {昨夜|ゆうべ}{夫婦喧嘩|ふうふげんか}をしてしまった。
examples.english: We ended up having a marital quarrel last night.

examples.japanese: {夫婦喧嘩|ふうふげんか}は{犬|いぬ}も{食|く}わない。
examples.english: Even a dog won't touch a married couple's quarrel. (proverb)

examples.japanese: ささいなことで{夫婦喧嘩|ふうふげんか}になったが、{翌朝|よくあさ}には{仲直|なかなお}りした。
examples.english: We got into a marital fight over something trivial, but made up the next morning.

notes:
Combines {夫婦|ふうふ} (married couple) + {喧嘩|けんか}; the け becomes げ by rendaku.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夫婦喧嘩|ふうふげんか}をする: to have a marital quarrel
- {夫婦喧嘩|ふうふげんか}が{絶|た}えない: marital fights never stop

CULTURAL NOTE:
The proverb {夫婦喧嘩|ふうふげんか}は{犬|いぬ}も{食|く}わない ('not even a dog will touch a married couple's quarrel') means outsiders should not meddle, since couples soon make up.
